name: N to Iu Na no Otoko, B to Iu Na no Onna
original_name: Nと言う名の男、Bと言う名の女
source:
A lonely, bullied girl opens up to a male teacher who was newly appointed at her school.

What she doesn't know is that he's got some plans concerning her...
